title: Collapse duplicate approval queue entries
summary: Updated the macOS approval queue to collapse duplicate-looking plan requests for the same repository, branch, and current plan content. Pending approvable requests win over stale duplicates; otherwise the newest request is displayed.
userVisibleChange: The approval window no longer shows two identical entries for the same plan/task.

risks.title: Automated code-review agents timed out before returning findings
risks.mitigation: The diff was manually inspected and covered by focused duplicate-collapse tests plus app build/test.

decisions.title: Collapse duplicates in the client queue
decisions.rationale: The daemon keeps durable stale audit records, so the native app should normalize the review queue for human readability without deleting local history.

decisions.title: Prefer pending requests over stale duplicates
decisions.rationale: If a fresh declaration exists for the same plan content, it is the actionable item and should be shown instead of a stale terminal record.

decisions.title: Use timestamps to choose between stale duplicates
decisions.rationale: Repeated stale declarations of the same plan should show the newest relevant request.

validation.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project EVEApproval.xcodeproj -scheme EVEApproval -configuration Release -destination platform=macOS build
